note: Illustrative, non-canonical machine-readable companion to decisions/ADR-0026-custody-ledger-v2-migration.md. Not read by packages/runner/test/cycle/money-schemas.test.mjs, any CI gate, specs/requirements.json, or architecture/interfaces.json. Do not treat any value below as an approved or observed figure; every amount is a placeholder chosen only to satisfy the existing atomic-string and address-format conventions.
scope: verifiedCurrentBalance and its admission rule apply only to the canonical EVM USDG row in this revision. No Solana observation producer is defined; a non-EVM-USDG v2 row stays permanently unvalued and fail-closed under the same rule until a future revision defines one.

unchangedFromV1.source: packages/runner/src/cycle/money-schemas.mjs:63-78 (CUSTODY_LEDGER_BUCKETS), unchanged names, order, and atomic-string semantics

legacyReplayContract.storedJournalBytes: never rewritten; a historical thirteen-bucket hookemon.custody-ledger.v1 entry stays exactly as persisted
legacyReplayContract.projectedValue: assertCustodyLedger(..., {allowLegacyBuckets: true}) backfills heldPositions: '0' in the value returned to callers only -- this is the shape describeCycle/projectPolicyCustody/the dashboard actually see, and it never gains a v2 field

canonicalAssetIdentity.provenance: identical to claimCustodyAsset's existing formula (claim-process.mjs:635-641) applied to configured.chainId/configured.usdg instead of money.assets.usdg -- claim-process.mjs:73-75 already asserts these two sources are equal before any claim proceeds, so both routes to the canonical identity produce the same value

preConstructionGate.onMismatch: refuse the write -- do not construct or append a ledger row
preConstructionGate.why: the ledger row's own decimals field is always sourced from money.assets.usdg.decimals, never copied from leg.destinationDecimals, so this check exists to catch a settled leg whose actual decimals convention disagrees with configuration, not to sanitize the row (which is already safe by construction)

canonicalAssetIdentity.whereResolutionHappens: the return stage (return.mjs) only -- it already holds money and the raw RELAY_CONSTANTS-derived comparison values. CycleRepository receives the already-resolved canonical chainId/assetId/decimals as part of the ledger row payload and performs no resolution of its own: it is constructed from a directory and a clock only (cycle-repository.mjs:2492-2513) and takes no injected configuration anywhere.
canonicalAssetIdentity.failureModeIfMisresolved: a stray, unreferenced ledger row at a wrong key -- never a merge or overwrite of an existing row, because chainId/assetId are part of custodyLedgerKey itself
canonicalAssetIdentity.notAGeneralFramework: one fixed formula for the one asset in scope this revision; not an N-chain/N-asset resolver

fields.account: non-empty string; the configured Operations EVM address
fields.balance: TypedAmount ({chainId, assetId, decimals, amountAtomic}); chainId/assetId/decimals MUST equal the owning ledger row's own canonical identity
fields.finality: {height: atomic-string block number, hash: non-empty string, timestampUnixSeconds: atomic-string|null} -- assertRelayFinality's exact shape, money-schemas.mjs:457-463

hookemon.custody-balance-observation.v1.producer: a new adapters-layer function, EVM USDG row only, reusing the public/archive/public-recheck evidence pattern payout-availability.mjs#reloadFinalizedOperationsUsdgBalance already implements (packages/adapters/src/app/payout-availability.mjs:199-227) without calling into or modifying that file

fields.verifiedCurrentBalance: CustodyBalanceObservationV1 | null -- new; null permitted only on a key's first-ever write
fields.expectedCycleAsset: TypedAmount | null; when non-null its chainId/assetId/decimals MUST equal the row's own canonical identity -- new

expectedCycleAssetRule.writeTimeGuard: the new return-leg-recording repository method refuses to append a second RECORDED return-direction leg whose resolved destination chain/asset matches an already-unresolved leg's on the same cycle -- the append does not happen; the row's existing expectedCycleAsset is left unchanged
expectedCycleAssetRule.consequence: a row can never durably hold more than one unresolved expectation, so expectedCycleAsset is a safe nullable scalar, not a collection
expectedCycleAssetRule.onRefusal: not one of ADR-0024's named semantic-invalid classes; how the calling stage surfaces this as an owner-visible state is an open fact for the implementation task

expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.returnLegState: no return leg recorded for this row's resolved chain/asset
exactly one, RECORDED (the only state a second write could reach, since a competing second leg is refused before append)
expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.expectedCycleAsset: {chainId, assetId, decimals, amountAtomic} from leg.destinationChainId/Asset/Decimals/AmountAtomic, resolved to the row's canonical identity
expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.writtenBy: one new atomic append (leg + ledger row together), following the recordHeldPosition precedent at cycle-repository.mjs:3730-3772

expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.note: cleared in the same existing atomic append that adds the amount to returnReceived (cycle-repository.mjs:1074-1150) -- no new call site needed here

expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.returnLegState: that leg transitions to HELD_RELAY_PARTIAL | HELD_RELAY_REFUND | HELD_RELAY_LATE | HELD_RELAY_WRONG_ASSET
expectedCycleAssetTransitionTable.note: current behavior writes no custody ledger row at all for a non-SETTLED outcome (cycle-repository.mjs:1140-1148); clearing this field requires a new dedicated atomic write this migration adds

acceptIf: the new observation is canonically identical in full to the previous one (same account, same balance, same finality -- exact idempotent replay, not just matching height/hash)
refuseIf: new finality.height == previous finality.height AND new finality.hash != previous finality.hash (same-height reorg)
new finality.height == previous finality.height AND new finality.hash == previous finality.hash BUT account, balance, or timestampUnixSeconds differs (evidence rewrite at the same checkpoint)
previous verifiedCurrentBalance is non-null AND new verifiedCurrentBalance is null (erasure -- forbidden regardless of finality)
previous row schema is hookemon.custody-ledger.v2 AND new row schema is hookemon.custody-ledger.v1 (downgrade -- forbidden)
verifiedCurrentBalanceWriteRule.enforcedAt: CycleRepository#recordCustodyLedger's assertState callback (repository transition boundary) -- cycle-repository.mjs:5556-5568 is the existing check this extends
verifiedCurrentBalanceWriteRule.neverAllocateAcrossCycles: verifiedCurrentBalance.balance is a wallet-level observation; it is never summed, subtracted, or divided across the cycles that share its account, and it never substitutes for the payout-availability.mjs reader's own returnDelta + previousDust admission source

admissionRule.extends: projectPolicyCustody's existing unvaluedExposure flag (accounting-projection.mjs:568-577,626-631,736,774), currently set only for a foreign non-matching-asset ledger with nonzero POLICY_CUSTODY_CURRENT_BUCKETS
admissionRule.newCondition: also true for the canonical EVM USDG row when verifiedCurrentBalance is null AND (unresolvedClaim = claimed - returnReceived is positive OR any POLICY_CUSTODY_CURRENT_BUCKETS bucket on that row is nonzero)
admissionRule.whyNoWindow: a claim write always sets claimed before anything else touches the key, so this rule engages immediately after the first write that puts real money on the row -- never retained as v1 (no-check) admission behavior with an unknown v2 balance
admissionRule.unaffectedWhenValued: a row with a non-null verifiedCurrentBalance is never marked unvalued by this rule regardless of its custody buckets

exampleV2Row.exampleNote: example only: claimed 500000000, bridged out to Solana for purchase (bridgeOut 500000000), exactly one return leg RECORDED with a quoted destination of 498000000 (expectedCycleAsset), not yet SETTLED (returnReceived still 0). chainId/assetId here use RELAY_CONSTANTS.ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_ID (4663) and USDG_ADDRESS as the underlying real identity, wrapped in the canonical eip155 form -- this is the same value claimCustodyAsset produces for the claim row, not Relay's raw wire pair. verifiedCurrentBalance.balance is the Operations wallet's whole observed balance at that account and height -- it is unrelated in magnitude to this cycle's own 498000000 expectation and must not be read as this cycle's share of it.
